improvements: Refreshed the complete multipolygon outer ring and all eight real inner lightwells in both mesh geometry and exact polygon collision.
Retained six separately declared terminal skybridge identities while preserving neighbouring airport volumes.
Collision probes verify eight open court centres and a solid deck control.
remainingGaps: Seven source levels are converted using an estimated 3.05 m floor height; roof parapet, stair towers and precast bands remain estimates.
Individual skybridge endpoint geometry and vertical road/terminal connections retain previous measured approximations.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
